artDirection.styleSuffix: 16-bit SNES-style pixel art, flat orthographic side-view, hard contrast, cinematic dry corporate-apocalypse tone, clean rigid silhouette, isolated on a pure magenta #FF00FF background, high readability at the requested canvas size, limited color palette (<=32 colors), no anti-aliased blur, no soft gradients, sharp pixel-perfect edges, dithered shading only, black 1px outline where silhouette meets background, no text or letters unless specified
artDirection.negativePrompt: photorealistic, 3d render, smooth shading, anti-aliasing, blurred edges, painterly, watercolor, soft gradients, lens flare, bokeh, depth-of-field, camera grain, motion blur, cel shading, noise, jpeg artifacts, text labels, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, melted anatomy
artDirection.silhouetteRule: Every character / weapon / moving entity must be isolated on the pure magenta background so an alpha key recovers a clean transparent PNG. No background elements inside the keyed rectangle.
artDirection.downscale: Generate at recommended resolution, then downsample to output dimensions using nearest-neighbor. Never bilinear or lanczos for pixel art.
postProcess: 3. Key near-#FF00FF background to alpha (RGB-distance tolerance 24).
5. Index to <=32 colors (optional; preserves palette discipline).

gemini.instructionStyle: Use the prompt verbatim. Preserve exact layout, grid, dimensions, magenta key background, and post-process requirements.

_sharedRules.layoutDirective: Strict sprite sheet grid: EXACTLY 6 columns x 12 rows, each frame centered in its 128x128 generation cell (target 64x64 after 2x nearest-neighbor downscale), no gutters. Character facing camera-right in every frame. Character silhouette is a TALL HUMAN FIGURE with aspect approximately 1:2 — roughly 28 pixels wide by 52 pixels tall in the 64x64 final cell. Do NOT draw a square silhouette. Center the body horizontally with about 18 pixels of pure magenta #FF00FF padding on each side, and about 6 pixels of magenta padding above the head and below the feet. The figure's in-sim hitbox is 26 wide by 52 tall; the drawn silhouette should read as roughly that shape at a glance so combat reads correctly. Weapons NOT drawn on this sheet (weapons are a separate layer).

taunt.sama: index finger raised as if consulting a graph only they can see
taunt.demis: drawing a small diagram in the air

generationStrategy: Strategy A (preferred): generate three animation rows at a time as a 768x384 strip with a 6x3 grid of exact 128x128 cells and no gutters. Downscale each strip exactly 2x to 384x192 nearest-neighbor, then compose four strips into the final 384x768 sheet.
Strategy B (fallback): ask for the full 6x12 grid in one shot with strict layoutDirective. Expect lower alignment reliability and more re-rolls.
